# DECISIONS.md — Momentum Trading Bot

Architecture and governance decision log. Append-only; newest first.

Record a decision whenever work goes through the `architecture-review` graph, a policy exception is granted, or a governance requirement is deliberately traded off.

## Format

```
## D-NNNN: <title> (<YYYY-MM-DD>)
- Status: proposed | accepted | superseded by D-MMMM
- Context: why a decision was needed
- Decision: what was decided
- Consequences: what this commits us to
- Evidence: link to evidence bundle / review artifacts
```
